title: Stored OpenAI and Anthropic assistant replay
pins: Provider-native ordered replay state must survive a stored assistant message into the next request in PHP, TypeScript and Python. Opaque encrypted reasoning, thinking signatures and redacted blocks are never reconstructed from convenience text.
scope: Non-stream request mapping, replay precedence, order and opaque values. No tool execution, network, live credentials or stream termination is exercised.

discrimination.note: Both native stored-message round trips reject bypassing either provider's replay and corrupting encrypted reasoning or thinking signatures (eight deliberate source defects total); restored controls pass. The generic keep-empty-tools probe also rejects every request row. Goldens execute Packagist core0.135.0.

findings: G-120: existing OpenAI request corpus has no output_items replay; no Anthropic request suite exists. Goldens execute published core0.135.0 native payload builders, never authored expectations.
